test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A machine is purchased for {₹}80,000. Its value depreciates at the rate of 10\% per year. What will be its value after 3 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Initial Value (P) = ₹80,000

Depreciation Rate (r) = 10%

Time (t) = 3 years

**Formula used:**

A = P × (1 - r/100)t

**Calculations:**

A = 80,000 × (1 - 10/100)³

⇒ A = 80,000 × (1 - 0.1)³

⇒ A = 80,000 × 0.9³

⇒ A = 80,000 × 0.729

⇒ A = ₹58,320

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
